trial_court: Addl. Principal Judge, Rohini, Delhi in HMA No. 1320/2012
case_name: Shri Ravinder Pratap Singh vs Hema
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 11.05.2011. Marriage was consummated but no issue was born. Parties stayed together till August, 2011. Marital discord arose due to non-satisfaction of dowry demand.

legal_principles.principle: Mere oral deposition of an interested witness making general allegations on oath does not prove the factum of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The learned Family Court further erred in concluding that cruel treatment was given to the respondent-wife at matrimonial home particularly when there is only an unmarried younger brother and an unmarried sister, no prudent person can think, that such cruel treatment could be caused to the respondent-wife.

legal_principles.principle: In the absence of any specific allegation of cruelty and narration of any specific instance of cruelty, granting the decree of divorce in favour of the respondent-wife was a perverse order.
legal_principles.held: In absence of any specific allegation of cruelty and narration of any specific instance of cruelty, granting the decree of divorce in favour of the respondent-wife by the learned Family Court was a perverse order.
